IL.sourceStatus: 2026 primary draft schedules available; complete 2026 IL-1040 instructions not yet posted (instructions column says coming soon).

verifiedFacts.baseModel: federal AGI plus Illinois additions minus Illinois subtractions equals Illinois base income; subtract applicable exemption allowances before applying the flat rate
verifiedFacts.rounding: whole dollars; drop cents below 0.50 and round 0.50 or more upward

contractRequirements: Schedule IL-E/EITC dependent exemption, EITC and under-12 child credit worksheets
all filing-status and exemption phaseout cases

IN.sourceStatus: 2026 DOR Tax Chapter and county rate schedule are available; 2026 IT-40/IT-40PNR full individual instructions and full schedules were not present on current-year forms page at audit time (2025 booklets still listed).

verifiedFacts.countyTax: separate county income tax applies; 2026 county rates effective October 1, 2026 are published in Departmental Notice 1
verifiedFacts.federalConformity: IRC as amended and in effect January 1, 2026, subject to Indiana modifications
verifiedFacts.nonresidentQualifiedInvestmentPartnershi: excluded effective January 1, 2026 when statutory qualified partnership conditions are met

state and county rate stacking and caps
dependent exemptions, elderly/adoption/EITC and other credits
2026-only tips/overtime/vehicle-interest eligibility, limits and filing-status restrictions
IRC conformity/add-backs including research and qualified production property

MI.sourceStatus: 2026 rate and withholding exemption are officially published; full 2026 MI-1040 instructions were not located. The currently indexed 40-page MI-1040 booklet is explicitly labeled tax year 2025 and must not be treated as 2026 final-return instructions.

verifiedFacts.federalBase: federal AGI with Michigan additions and subtractions; Michigan exemption then applied
verifiedFacts.localIncomeTax: city income taxes are separate; Detroit individual return is administered through Treasury

contractRequirements: final 2026 MI-1040 booklet and Schedule 1/NR/4884 instructions
2026 personal exemption and age/blind/dependent rules for final liability (do not assume withholding certificate equals all return rules)
2026 retirement/pension and Social Security subtractions including birth-year transition
city income taxes including Detroit and any supported city-rate inputs

CO.sourceStatus: January 2026 official Individual Income Tax Guide contains 2026 law changes; current DR 0104 page still links 2025/2024 forms and guide's rate table only lists through 2025. No official 2026 rate located.

verifiedFacts.baseModel: federal taxable income plus Colorado additions minus Colorado subtractions
verifiedFacts.overtimeDeduction: full federal Schedule 1-A overtime deduction is added back for 2026 and later
verifiedFacts.qualifiedTips: no Colorado addback for federal qualified tips deduction
verifiedFacts.filingStatus: same as federal; joint federal return generally requires joint Colorado return
